title: SWF: DefineEditText tag (tag 37) encoding
description: Test that a Frame with a TextDisplayObject (if it exists) or simulated EditText definition produces DefineEditText (tag 37). Verify: tag 37 body has HasText flag when initial text is non-empty, HasMaxLength flag, HasFont flag referencing a font ID, InitialText stored as null-terminated string. Check what text display objects look like in engine/types.ts.
